steps.content: On the deck, you immediately spot Pylgia tinkering with some diving equipment.
You wave at Pylgia. She looks up, notices you, and waves back.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: How are you feeling? Is everything alright?
The conversation feels familiar, except this time you're the one asking.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't worry, Pylgia's in even better shape than you are. Her suit was shredded, but she came back without a single scratch.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: She gave me a big fright! I checked her over many times before I was convinced enough to let her go...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...It's all thanks to our guide. Without him, I wouldn't have made it back.
steps.female_content: ...It's all thanks to our guide. Without her, I wouldn't have made it back.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I feel well. Not like in the Abyss. And I don't... want to go back to being like that again.
Pylgia, you still up there? Come give us a hand!
Pylgia gives you an apologetic look. There are too many secrets between you, too many things unsaid, but now isn't the time.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Wait for me at camp... And thank you for keeping my secret.
You nod at her, and she quickly disappears below deck, her steps much lighter than before.
